text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Damping controls overshoot and the shape of a second-order response

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: All curves have unit DC gain and zero initial state. Green band is ±2% of the final value. The 4/(ζω_n) settling relation is an underdamped approximation,
not an exact general formula or a formula for the plotted overdamped curve. Actual last band crossing can differ.
